밑줄 친 부분에 들어갈 접속사 중 나머지와 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ①은 "Because she lives nearby, I can see her very often"로 인과관계(원인-결과)를 나타내고, ②④⑤는 "Although"로 대비/양보(~하지만)를 나타냅니다. 따라서 ①이 나머지와 다릅니다.

options: Ants never take a rest and work hard all the time.
Worker ants take short naps 90 times day by day.
Male ants fall asleep 250 times every other day.

questions.question:
[지문]
Ants seem to be busy all the time and never rest. But this is not true. Worker ants rest by taking very short naps about 250 times a day. Each of these naps lasts only about a minute. This means that the worker ants sleep for about four hours each day. On the other hand, queen ants fall asleep 90 times a day, and they sleep for about six minutes at a time. This means that they sleep for about nine hours each day. In short, ants sleep and rest just like us, though they do so in a different way. There are some fun facts about ants. Some queen ants live up to 30 years. Some ants can carry things that are 50 times their own body weight. Ants do not have lungs but breathe through small holes in their bodies and have two stomachs. One stomach holds food for itself, and the other holds food to share with others. Most ants can swim and live 24 hours underwater.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'Some queen ants live up to 30 years'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 4번이 정답입니다. 1번은 거짓(ants do rest), 2번은 잘못된 수(90번 아니라 250번), 3번은 잘못된 정보(250번은 worker ants), 5번은 거짓(폐 없이 작은 구멍으로 호흡)입니다.

(A) But this is not true. Worker ants rest by taking very short naps about 250 times a day.
(B) In short, ants sleep and rest just like us, though they do so in a different way.
(C) Each of these naps lasts only about a minute. This means that the worker ants sleep for about four hours each day.
(D) On the other hand, queen ants fall asleep 90 times a day, and they sleep for about six minutes at a time. This means that they sleep for about nine hours each day.
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장 '개미는 항상 바쁘고 쉰다'에 대해 (A)에서 '그건 사실이 아니다'라고 시작하고, (C)에서 worker ants의 수면에 대해 자세히 설명하고, (D)에서 queen ants와 비교하고, (B)에서 결론을 짓는 것이 논리적입니다.

options: 수개미는 여왕개미가 알을 낳는 것을 도와준다.
여왕개미는 알을 낳고 수개미의 일도 도와준다.
questions.question:
[지문]
Ants live in colonies which have lots of residents living together. Within a colony, there are usually three different types of ants. There is the queen, and what she does her entire life is lay eggs. The second type of ant is the male that helps the queen produce these eggs. The third type of ant is the worker. Worker ants are all female and do very important jobs, like caring for eggs, defending the colony, and collecting food.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것을 모두 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 1번은 일치합니다(males help the queen produce eggs). 2번은 지문에서 언급되지 않습니다. 3번은 일치합니다(caring for eggs, defending the colony). 4번은 거짓입니다(Worker ants are all female). 5번은 거짓입니다(queen only lays eggs). 따라서 1번과 3번이 일치합니다.
